provenance.historical_grid_status: Not recorded; exact disjointness from the undocumented historical pilot screen cannot be proven.
provenance.freshness: Fixed before evaluating; disjoint track IDs and geometry seeds from every documented previous evaluation. All geometry seeds reserved from new training.
provenance.historical_ppo_status: Unmatched historical evidence only; reward, representation and effective sampler streams differ. No causal algorithm-only comparison claimed.

gates.screen: Nonzero canonical completion plus exact two-reload traces and CPU operational eligibility.
gates.confirmation: Freeze the screen-selected actor hash before fresh confirmation. Nonzero finishes on both identical independent reload passes; repeats are a determinism test, not additional independent cells.
gates.scale_up: Screen and confirmation pass; four training seeds with the same indexed sampled-track stream and explicit CPU checkpoint selection. Not final submission promotion.
gates.blind: Only the frozen selected candidate after confirmation. No selection or tuning on blind cells.
gates.submission: Repeated unseen completion, blind and CPU Torch 2.1 package gates; no package release from progress alone.

matched_scale_up.sampled_track_protocol: numpy.default_rng(917): independently draw track ID and uint32 geometry seed each episode, reject all protocol seeds. Equal episode-index streams, not equal consumed prefix lengths.
matched_scale_up.reward: raw official reward; no normalization, shaping, collision penalty or smoothing
matched_scale_up.budget_comparator: 1048576 high-level decisions matches historical PPO budget only; no historical PPO run is a fully matched frozen-contract control.
matched_scale_up.freshness_after_selection: The confirmation and blind partitions above certify only the pilot decision. Scale-up requires new pre-registered confirmation/blind cells, never reuse these for final promotion.
